floor_history.headline: Recon: floors re-confirmed at HEAD (12/candidate, 15/stream-exact); FIVE axes killed with measurements — K&R params inert, SOTN reference is a different library build (constant clamps vs BB2's global

frontier.hypothesis: A 2-atom (pairwise) pref/conflict model perturbation reaches the full target assignment AND corresponds to a spellable pure-C construct
frontier.mechanism: s0 scanned single atoms only (3 hits, all needing unreachable hard regs); s1 closed pure order shifts; pairwise pref/conflict changes are the only unexplored model space (~273^2 combos, simulable in minutes with order_scan.py-style harness)
frontier.next_probe: extend tmp/c7a0_a2_scan.py to atom PAIRS checking full-target reachability; for any hit, assess C-spellability before writing any C

frontier.hypothesis: Already-matched verbatim-Sony LIBGPU SYS module siblings (e.g. the 0xE2000000 packet builder preceding this function, and other census module members) reveal how/whether target-style allocations were reached in pure C
frontier.mechanism: same library build, same compiler era; a COMPLETED-C sibling with an analogous raw-halfword carrier copy would be direct evidence of a reachable spelling family — or their completion states may show the module carries regfix debt uniformly, supporting the toolchain-revision-divergence reading
frontier.next_probe: map the census module members to queue/completion states; diff the C of any COMPLETED-C member with a carrier-copy prologue against stream51

frontier.hypothesis: If both frontier probes come back empty, the pure-C evidence package is complete (atoms, orders, retry, cc1psx, TU, K&R, flags all measured dead) for the driver's escalation modality
frontier.mechanism: endgame-lock disposition is the driver/owner's call after the modality ladder; a session must not self-declare exhaustion outside escalation modality
frontier.next_probe: driver-assigned; no session action until the ladder mandates it
